headline: Spatial omics models link histology and gene relationships to expression
label: Spatial Quantification And Identifiability
summary: Spatial and single-cell datasets now support gene-wise and neighborhood-level inference with explicit units of quantification.
synthesis: The dominant thread is the explicit specification of what is quantified and tested. MorphoANOVA fits gene-wise nested spatially varying coefficient models with sequential ANOVA to relate H&E morphology to spatial expression, while GeneSPOT applies gene-centric optimal transport to measure how spatial gene relationships reorganize across conditions and time. Sphinx models adaptive spatial neighborhoods in spatial proteomics, and PANGEA provides a 32-type, 165-subtype hierarchical atlas of 12.6M cells for profiling multicellular responses across human disease. CellChat Hotspot refines cell-cell communication inference with gene-set enrichment and context-driven filtering, validated with spatial transcriptomics. BEHAV3D-Explorer applies natural-language configuration to time-resolved 3D live microscopy. What is new is the move from global summaries toward gene-, relationship- and neighborhood-level inference with explicit units of inference.
